elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon either expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Commerce One must provide transition assistance to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must, at Corio’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for a period of up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Commerce One’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “Commerce One’s then-current standard rates,” which satisfies then-current rates.

elements.element: Commerce One must return Customer Data to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must return “all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One’s possession or control.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from “Corio’s written request,” not from expiry or termination. If Corio delays its request, return can occur more than 30 days after the exit event.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” satisfying a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Commerce One must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return, Commerce One must “thereafter delete such data” from its systems.

elements.element: Commerce One must certify deletion after the data is returned and deleted.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must “certify such deletion to Corio in writing” after deleting the returned data.

elements.element: The transition-assistance and data-export obligations apply upon either expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 is expressly triggered “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Commerce One must provide transition assistance to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must provide reasonable transition assistance at Corio’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for a period of up to six months, which permits Corio to request and receive a 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Commerce One must export or return Customer Data to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must return all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users in its possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported or returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative deadline is 30 days after Corio’s written request rather than 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The clause substantively provides six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return, deletion, and written certification. However, the data-return deadline is measured from Corio’s written request rather than from expiry or termination, so neither the preferred nor fallback timing requirement is fully met. The drafting also adds broader treatment of Confidential Information and customer/user data beyond what is necessary, but it preserves the existing surviving rights and does not create an irreconcilable contradiction.
